No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you read monumental mosque architecture with respectful active-site interpretation.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Exterior scale and approach
  • Permitted visitor areas only
  • Stylistic details and context
  • Living heritage discussion

How the time is spent

  1. Exterior scale and approach 15 min

  2. Permitted visitor areas only 35 min

  3. Stylistic details and context 35 min

  4. Living heritage discussion 20 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Describe the scale of a monumental mosque and how it is approached from outside.
  • Identify stylistic details of Taj-ul-Masajid and place them in their context.
  • Discuss how to interpret an active religious site respectfully, visiting permitted areas only.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.

Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh
